intel.title: [CISA KEV] Fortinet FortiMail - Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-104286
廠商: Fortinet
產品: FortiMail
漏洞名稱: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
說明: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-04
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Fortinet FortiMail 存在路徑遍歷與 NULL 位元組注入漏洞（CVE-2026-104286），已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單。未經身分驗證的攻擊者可透過特製的 HTTP/HTTPS 請求在系統中寫入任意檔案，進而可能導致遠端代碼執行（RCE）。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
